queries: WITH per_transaction AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS overall_avg FROM per_transaction), kept AS (SELECT p.transref, p.avg_anlycount, o.overall_avg FROM per_transaction p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_anlycount > o.overall_avg), kept_with_avg AS (SELECT transref, avg_anlycount, overall_avg, AVG(avg_anlycount) OVER () AS kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT transref, avg_anlycount, avg_anlycount - overall_avg AS above_overall_avg, avg_anlycount - kept_avg AS above_kept_avg FROM kept_with_avg ORDER BY above_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS WITH TIES

WITH per_transaction AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS overall_avg FROM per_transaction), kept AS (SELECT p.transref, p.avg_anlycount FROM per_transaction p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_anlycount > o.overall_avg), kept_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.transref, k.avg_anlycount, k.avg_anlycount - o.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg, k.avg_anlycount - ka.kept_avg AS above_kept_avg FROM kept k CROSS JOIN overall o CROSS JOIN kept_average ka ORDER BY above_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS WITH TIES;
